propositions: Newly added hard-fail CI gates break in-flight branches that predate the gate, with no compatibility check in the code-review gate.
The applies_to glob seam in criteria_routing.json must gate project criteria dispatch to only changed files matching pipeline-config paths, avoiding CI-vendor hard-coding.
The glob set must be project-overridable via config key [code_review] ci_config_globs so unusual pipelines are declared, not enumerated in shipped code.

A CI-agnostic rubric must ask whether a pipeline/gate change introduces a hard-fail step with no grandfather guard, applicable across GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Buildkite, Bitbucket Pipelines, Drone, and Azure Pipelines.

The gate_dispatch and registry code paths must filter activated project criteria by their effective applies_to globs against the review's changed files, reusing glob_match and respecting empty applies_to as always-on.
The criterion must ship advisory (non-blocking) with default_posture advisory and block_threshold 0.90, calibrated on a balanced 6/6 fire/pass eval corpus before flipping to blocking.
